articles.title: Schelling Goodness, and Shared Morality as a Goal

curriculum.summary: This article explores the concept of Schelling goodness, a notion that refers to a class of hypothetical coordination games where participants aim to converge on a moral verdict. It assumes knowledge of moral philosophy, game theory, and coordination games, and builds on these concepts to discuss the idea of shared morality as a goal.
